Export the bundled energyRt model as a solver workspace

Source: R/export_model_source.R
export_model_source.Rd

Writes the energyRt model shipped in example_models to a directory, as a model workspace (see save_model()) with one sub-directory per requested backend under solvers/. The GAMS source is the file the model was parsed from; the MathProg, JuMP and Pyomo code is rendered from the parsed model with write_gmpl(), write_jump() and write_pyomo().

Usage

export_model_source(
  dataset = c("energyrt"),
  dir,
  format = "all",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

dataset

Name of the dataset to export. Currently only "energyrt".

dir

Directory path for the workspace. Created if it does not exist.

format

Which backend to export: "gams", "gmpl", "jump", "pyomo", or "all" (default).

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, existing solver directories are rewritten. Default is FALSE: a backend whose directory exists is skipped.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, print progress messages. Default is TRUE.

Value

Invisibly, a character vector of the files written.

Details

The workspace layout is the one every solve_*() function expects:

  • model.rds, sets/, mappings/, parameters/: the saved model and its data (CSV), written once by save_model().

  • solvers/gams/model.gms: the GAMS source of the energyRt model.

  • solvers/gmpl/model.mod and data.dat: MathProg, run with glpsol -m model.mod -d data.dat from that directory.

  • solvers/jump/model.jl and data.jl: JuMP, run with julia model.jl.

  • solvers/pyomo/model.py and data.py: Pyomo, run with python model.py.

  • README.txt: provenance and licence of the model.

Examples

# \donttest{
ws <- file.path(tempdir(), "energyrt_ws")
files <- export_model_source("energyrt", ws, format = "gmpl")
#> Created directory: C:\Users\admin\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpgRRJWR/energyrt_ws
#> Wrote: model workspace (model.rds, sets/, mappings/, parameters/)
#> Wrote: README.txt
#> Wrote: solvers/gmpl/ (model.mod, data.dat)
#> Export complete: 4 file(s) written to C:\Users\admin\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpgRRJWR\energyrt_ws
basename(files)
#> [1] "model.rds"  "README.txt" "model.mod"  "data.dat"  

model <- read_gmpl(file.path(ws, "solvers", "gmpl", "model.mod"),
                   file.path(ws, "solvers", "gmpl", "data.dat"))
